newsitem.title: FRANCE: France, Germany in Tiger production agreement.
newsitem.headline: France, Germany in Tiger production agreement.

text.p: France and Germany announced on Wednesday that they had agreed on the division of production work on the Franco-German combat helicopter project Tiger.

"An agreement has been found on the distribution of production lines for the Tiger between France and Germany," said Jean-Yves Helmer, head of the French defence procurement office, after meeting his German defence counterpart, Gunthar Simon.
He added that the tooling for the Tiger production would start "in the next few weeks."
One production line will be set up in Donauworth near Munich and the other at Marignane near Marseille.
The Tiger was developed by Eurocopter, which is 70 percent owned by Aerospatiale and 30 percent by Daimler-Benz Aerospace (DASA).
France plans to buy 25 Tiger helicopters between 2000 and 2002.
